column.name: report_sql
column.value: SELECT r.business_date AS business_date, b.step_order AS step_order, g.step_name AS step, g.row_no AS row_no, g.kind AS kind, g.logical_name AS name, g.fin_source_gl AS fin_source_gl, g.fin_bridge_gl AS fin_bridge_gl, g.flex_source_gl AS flex_source_gl, g.flex_bridge_gl AS flex_bridge_gl, g.flex_source_branch AS flex_source_branch, g.flex_bridge_branch AS flex_bridge_branch, g.side AS side, g.normal_side AS normal_side, g.flipped AS flipped, g.amount AS amount, g.expected AS expected, g.actual AS actual, g.fin_balance AS fin_balance, g.flex_balance AS flex_balance, g.fin_status AS fin_status, g.flex_status AS flex_status, g.drift_status AS drift_status, g.check_result AS check_result, g.reference AS reference, g.note AS note FROM m_eod_gl_result g JOIN m_eod_run r ON r.id = g.run_id LEFT JOIN m_batch_business_steps b ON b.job_name = 'EOD_CLOSE_OF_BUSINESS' AND b.step_name = g.step_name WHERE r.business_date = '${endDate}' UNION ALL SELECT r.business_date, b.step_order, g.step_name, 0, 'TOTAL', NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, SUM(g.amount), SUM(g.expected), SUM(g.actual), NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL FROM m_eod_gl_result g JOIN m_eod_run r ON r.id = g.run_id LEFT JOIN m_batch_business_steps b ON b.job_name = 'EOD_CLOSE_OF_BUSINESS' AND b.step_name = g.step_name WHERE r.business_date = '${endDate}' GROUP BY r.business_date, b.step_order, g.step_name ORDER BY step_order, step, row_no
